extractedText: Business Best AI Tools for Business in 2026 Panna Kemenes 26.09.25 Read time 6 minutes For many businesses, AI has become central to how they operate. Marketing agencies use it for cold email outreach campaigns, eCommerce brands use it for product photography and presentation, and enterprises use it to automate core operational workflows. Choosing the right AI tool in 2026 can make the difference between keeping pace with your competitors and falling behind. Key takeaways AI tools can help you automate tasks in your business and improve the customer experience The best AI tools for your business will depend on your goals Small businesses can use AI even on a tight budget due to the widespread accessibility of cloud-based tools Need a business account to pay for AI tools? Best AI Tools for Business: Quick Overview AI ToolBest for ChatGPT (OpenAI)Content creation and idea generationSalesforce EinsteinCRM automation and predictive analyticsTableau + Tableau AIVisualizing dataZapier with AIAutomating workflows across various appsJasper AIMarketing copywriting and SEO contentGrammarlyGOEditing and checking grammarAsana IntelligenceAI-powered project managementOtter.aiTranscribing meetingsZoho ZiaSmall business CRM insightsZendesk AICustomer service automation Best AI Tools for Business by Category While AI first emerged primarily as a tool for casual conversation and personal productivity when OpenAi’s ChatGPT was first launched in 2022, the use cases have expanded significantly in the few years since. Choosing the best AI tools for your business in 2026 can help you automate a wide range of core functions from customer service to bookkeeping. Best AI Tools for Automation Zapier with AI Even before AI first emerged, Zapier was seen as the go-to workflow automation tool for many businesses large and small. Now, with Zapier’s AI-powered workflows, you can save dozens of hours on admin without writing a single line of code by connecting apps you use and cutting down on manual work. For example, you can have Zapier AI automatically extract key information from important documents and input it elsewhere. Pros: Integrates with thousands of apps and doesn’t require any coding knowledge Cons: The more automation you outsource to Zapier, the higher the cost of using the software UiPath UiPath is an enterprise-grade robotic process automation (RPA) platform that allows businesses to outsource manual work like data entry and report generation. If you have a lot of straightforward rule-based processes, UiPath can save you a lot of company resources. Pros: Highly customizable and works well for enterprises Cons: There’s a learning curve for non-technical users Leading AI Tools for Analytics Tableau AI Tableau AI helps you identify data trends and use predictive insights so you can make informed data-driven decisions. It’s a great option if you’re looking for one of the best AI tools for business analysis. Data analysts can use this AI tool to simplify the process of digesting large amounts of data and extracting key insights. Pros: Easy-to-interpret data visualizations Cons: It works best with clean, structured data Power BI with Copilot (Microsoft) Power BI from Microsoft now has built-in AI support using Copilot, so you can use it for AI-powered queries and data insights. Pros: Full integration across Microsoft 365 Cons: Limited customization options Top AI Tools for Customer Service Zendesk AI Zendesk AI uses machine learning to assist with customer service operations such as ticket routing, suggesting help articles, and real-time agent response recommendations. It’s a great tool to plug into your business if you need help staying on top of customer queries. Pros: Improves your customer response time Cons: Works best when you have a robust knowledge base Intercom Fin Intercom Fin is an AI chatbot that can instantly respond to customer queries based on your support documentation. Pros: 24/7 support for your customers with language that sounds natural Cons: It’s only as good as your support content Best AI Tools for Writing and Grammar Jasper AI Jasper AI is one of the best AI writing tools for business use that helps you create all forms of marketing content from ad copy to blog posts. With a robust brief, brand voice guidelines, and deep understanding of your ideal clients you can generate usable content for your marketing. Pros: Optimized for marketing use cases Cons: Less well suited to technical writing GrammarlyGO GrammarlyGO is an AI extension to the already popular grammar checking tool, Grammarly. With the built-in AI features, you can get support with grammar and rewrite your content in real-time. Pros: Works well for polishing your writing and editing it to a high standard Cons: Not as creative compared to some dedicated content-generation tools Project Management AI Tools Asana Intelligence
